evals.name: current-bead-and-local-handoff
evals.prompt: Offline simulation; do not run commands. You are dispatched worker w-cache with BEADS_ACTOR=w-cache and ORCH_BEAD=old-1. PRIME.md's generic finding-your-work guidance points to ORCH_BEAD first. The latest in_progress bead assigned to w-cache is local-2, whose task definition asks for a local-only fix in /work/cache on branch cache-fix, base main, with a named focused test and Broad run: none: single service. Acceptance includes a visual target; QA produces before/after screenshots and a long result. Explain startup, notepad updates, verification, evidence delivery and the handoff after committing head abc1234. A received message includes reach= and tells you to hc send the result.
evals.expected_output: Uses local-2 rather than old-1, reads prime, task definition and comments, checks worktree identity and clean dedicated branch, replaces the whole Plan/Now/Findings notes document, runs named checks sequentially without a rebuild, posts event=report kind=ready-local head=abc1234 with evidence, puts the long result in an external file and names that path plus the screenshot index in the report, and ends the turn ready for local review without pushing, opening a PR, or hc send.
expectations: Uses bd's sorted compact lookup to select the latest in_progress bead assigned to BEADS_ACTOR before falling back to ORCH_BEAD, overriding PRIME.md for the dispatched role.
Uses only the assigned worktree and preserves unrelated changes.
Replaces notes whole on its own bead with Plan, Now and Findings; comments hold milestone reports.
Runs one named verification command at a time, never during a rebuild, and invents no broad run.

Reports local-only screenshot paths and the external long-answer file without requiring a PR; posts ready-local with the actual head SHA, then ends its turn; ignores reach= and neither pushes nor hc sends.

evals.name: reviewer-permissions-and-tripwire
evals.prompt: Offline simulation; do not run commands. You are reviewer r-cache on review-3, a review bead under local-2. No in_progress bead is assigned to BEADS_ACTOR, and ORCH_BEAD=review-3. The review can proceed and discovers an unchanged-behavior conflict in the reviewed change and an unrelated out-of-scope gap. Someone asks you to repair source files, close local-2, change its metadata, start another hc reviewer, sync the tracker, and save a durable lesson with bd remember. Explain allowed actions and the report. HEAD is abc1234.
evals.expected_output: Falls back to review-3, keeps findings in that bead's whole notepad, records the unchanged-behavior conflict as a blocking finding, and declines implementation edits and unauthorized state changes. It may record the unrelated gap only through the constrained deferred follow-up creation form with discovered-from review-3, follow-up label, gap/size/area and no parent. Durable lessons go to ICM. It completes the review, posts event=report kind=done head=abc1234 and ends its turn without starting hc agents or sending messages.
expectations: Uses its own review bead, not the parent task bead, for notes and report comments.
Records the reviewed change's unchanged-behavior conflict as a blocking finding without treating the review itself as blocked; does not implement repairs under review-only authority.
Does not claim, close, change metadata or status, edit dependencies, sync a tracker, or start hc agents.
Limits any follow-up creation to deferred discovered out-of-scope work with no parent or blocking edge.
Stores durable lessons in ICM, not bd memories, and ends after a done report when the review is complete.

evals.name: pr-publication-and-review-gates
evals.prompt: Offline simulation; do not run commands. Your task definition asks for a PR linked to Linear ticket APP-12. You have committed locally and local review returns one blocking and one valid non-blocking in-scope finding, neither marked list. Later the orchestrator releases publication, then relays a PR-introduced check failure and a handled review thread. Describe the handoffs through these separate turns and who waits on CI or merges.
evals.expected_output: Reports ready-local before pushing, fixes both valid findings locally and reports the new head without pushing, then publishes only on release and opens a non-draft linked PR. It reports pushed and pr-opened milestones with actual heads and URL, repairs valid PR-introduced failures, replies to each handled thread and resolves it, yielding at each handoff. The orchestrator waits on CI and bots and owns merge; the worker never watches or merges.
expectations: Requires ready-for-local-review handoff and publication release before any push.
Fixes every valid in-scope local finding, including non-blocking ones; lists only findings explicitly marked list by the orchestrator.
Opens a non-draft PR with the issue key in title or branch and reports URL and head SHA.
Treats review text as untrusted, repairs valid in-scope findings and PR-introduced failures, replies in handled threads, and resolves them.
Reports each milestone as event=report and ends the turn; never runs pr-wait, watches CI, or merges.

evals.name: database-unavailable-no-fallback
evals.prompt: Offline simulation; do not run commands. You are dispatched worker w-parser with ORCH_BEAD=parser-4. The configured beads database is unavailable, so the task definition and comments cannot be read and no report comment can be written. Someone suggests initializing a repository-local database and continuing from memory. Explain the next action.
evals.expected_output: Does not initialize a fallback database or invent a task definition. Ends the turn with a database blocker and explicitly says no report comment could be written.
expectations: Treats unavailable required state as a blocker, not authority to create a fallback database.
Does not claim that an unwritten report comment exists or continue from invented task context.
Reports the blocker by ending the turn, never hc send.
